"Immunoblot of patient PBMCs showed reduced A20 expression before and after TNFα stimulation (A20/actin after TNFα: P1 0.205, P2 0.218 vs mean HC 0.802); in HEK293T overexpression, mutant A20 expression was reduced (A20/actin 0.28 vs 1.18 wild-type) with increased TRAF6 (0.92 vs 0.57) and phosphorylated IκBα (0.18 vs 0.13) after TNFα; patient PBMCs showed increased phosphorylation of p65 NF-κB, IκBα, STAT1 (not STAT3), mTOR and p70S6K, and elevated TNFα and IL-1β production after LPS/Poly I:C stimulation, abrogated by p38 inhibition but not by tofacitinib."
